legend: There are n$$$n$$$ cities in some imaginary kingdom. All cities are connected by n−1$$$n - 1$$$ bidirectional roads. The toll to drive a single road is exactly 1$$$1$$$ credit in each direction.

Recently citizens have started to wonder why it's so expensive to drive across the country. King has decided to make some roads free of charge. He wants to choose a single road for each city and make the toll in the outgoing direction free for everybody. His goal is to minimize the maximum total toll among all direct road trips from one city to another. You should help him!
input: The first line contains a single positive integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤200000$$$2 \leq n \leq 200\,000$$$) — the number of cities in an imaginary kingdom.

Next n−1$$$n - 1$$$ lines contain two positive integers ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤ai,bi≤n$$$1 \leq a_i, b_i \leq n$$$) — the description of i$$$i$$$-th road, connecting cities ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$.
output: In the first line print a single integer d$$$d$$$ — the minimum total toll which would be required to pay for the most expensive road trip from one city to the other.

In the next line print n$$$n$$$ integers ei$$$e_i$$$ — the index of the road selected for the i$$$i$$$-th city to be free of charge. If no road is selected for the i$$$i$$$-th city print ei=−1$$$e_i = -1$$$.

legend.ai: 某个虚构的王国中有 n$$$n$$$ 座城市。所有城市由 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 条双向道路相连。沿单条道路行驶的通行费在每个方向上都恰好为 1$$$1$$$ 单位信用点。
最近，市民们开始疑惑，为什么驾车横穿全国如此昂贵。国王决定让一些道路免费通行。他希望为每座城市选择一条道路，并使所有人沿该道路驶出城市的方向免收通行费。他的目标是最小化所有从一座城市到另一座城市的直接驾车行程中，总通行费的最大值。请帮助他！

input.ai: 第一行包含一个正整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤200000$$$2 \leq n \leq 200\,000$$$)，表示虚构王国中的城市数量。
接下来的 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 行中，每行包含两个正整数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$(1≤ai,bi≤n$$$1 \leq a_i, b_i \leq n$$$)，表示第 i$$$i$$$ 条道路的描述，该道路连接城市 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$。

output.ai: 第一行输出一个整数 d$$$d$$$，表示从一座城市到另一座城市的最昂贵行程所需支付的最小总通行费。
下一行输出 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 ei$$$e_i$$$，表示为第 i$$$i$$$ 座城市选择的免费道路编号。如果没有为第 i$$$i$$$ 座城市选择道路，则输出 ei=−1$$$e_i = -1$$$。
